region_scene_page.compact: This road covers the 2000s/2010s moment when electronic dance music became a global festival and pop-radio language.
region_scene_page.standard: This road covers the 2000s/2010s moment when electronic dance music became a global festival and pop-radio language. David Guetta featuring Kelly Rowland's When Love Takes Over, Swedish House Mafia's One, Skrillex's Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites, and Calvin Harris' Summer give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: This road covers the 2000s/2010s moment when electronic dance music became a global festival and pop-radio language. Unlike Chicago house or Detroit techno, the center is maximal impact and crossover reach. David Guetta featuring Kelly Rowland's When Love Takes Over, Swedish House Mafia's One, Skrillex's Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites, and Calvin Harris' Summer give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
